soldier: Head capsule brownish yellow, mandibles purplish brown, labrum yellow-white with the centre of the dorsal surface pale brown, antennae pale yellow; thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellowish white. Pilosity of the head capsule moderate, the frons rather full, with two pairs of crossed short setae in front of the frontal gland aperture; the anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum each with more than 20 setae. Head capsule rectangular and rather short, head-width index 0.67–0.75, the sides nearly parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded, the coronal suture distinct and about half the length of the head capsule. In profile the region of the frontal gland aperture is slightly concave and the frontal slope above the aperture rather raised; the frontal gland aperture is a small chitinised tube set in a triangular shallow pit at the centre of the frontal slope. Labrum slightly longer than wide, inclined somewhat to the right, the apex semicircularly incised, the two anterior lateral corners pointed and projecting forwards. Apex of the left mandible hooked with a slight twist behind it, the middle section rather straight; right mandible sabre-shaped, the apex slightly curved and its point directed downwards. Antennae 14 segments, the second and fourth nearly equal in length, the third longer. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave, the posterior margin nearly straight. Apical tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented.
